literal_question.instructions: Is the other person's latest message meant literally, with no subtext?

criteria.true: plain statement, question or plan; no hint or test
criteria.false: subtext: a test, sarcasm, a hint or a hidden complaint

true_intent.instructions: What does the other person really want with the latest message?

criteria.confirm_you_care: testing whether you remember or still care
criteria.vent_anger: angry or hurt; wants the feeling acknowledged
criteria.request_action: wants a concrete action, time or commitment now
criteria.seek_explanation: wants to know why something happened
criteria.casual_chat: light friendly talk, no test and no conflict
criteria.close_topic: peacefully wrapping up; needs nothing more

danger_level.instructions: How close is this chat to a fight right now?
criteria: mild tease, easy to laugh off
unhappy, but still a chance to fix it
sarcasm or a test; a sloppy reply escalates
openly upset, says you do not care
an ultimatum is on the table
active rupture: it is over, do not reply

should_reply_now.instructions: Should your next message carry substance: a known fault, fact, time or plan?

criteria.true: the needed fact or plan is already in this chat
criteria.false: a holding line is safer, or the needed fact is missing

best_action.instructions: Which kind of next action fits best?

criteria.check_history: look up what they refer to first
criteria.apologize: sincerely apologize for a known mistake
criteria.give_commitment: give a concrete promise or deadline
criteria.acknowledge: show you heard them and care
criteria.say_less: keep it short or say nothing more
criteria.make_plan: propose or confirm a time, place or task

she_needs.instructions: What does the other person need from you now?

criteria.care: proof that you remember or care

tension_resolved.instructions: Is the tension in this chat already resolved?

criteria.true: no tension left, or they accepted and cooled down
criteria.false: still waiting, testing, angry or sarcastic
